comparison.objective: Scribe a shelf end to match an out-of-flat wall.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold the shelf fixed while guiding a pencil compass continuously along the wall profile.
comparison.success_condition: A continuous scribe matches target offsets at measured stations, with shelf stable and compass put down clear.
comparison.reason: Profile following and mark generation are different from coaxial recessed insertion, impact-force control, and fragment containment.
